title: Scheme to Promote Manufacturing of Sintered Rare Earth Permanent Magnets (₹7,280 Cr)
summary: Cabinet approved ₹7,280 Cr scheme for 6,000 MTPA REPM manufacturing under National Critical Mineral Mission with dedicated corridors in Odisha, Kerala, AP, TN.
